name: visiting-hours-house-round4
title: Visiting Hours: the house with your picks, the observatory raised, and the house from outside
subtitle: Built in: the oxblood regency stripe with a walnut wainscot in every room (the kitchen's and bath's tiles stay), exposed beams, the stepped crown, painted boards in the attic, and every ceiling 0.4 m higher for real (doors keep their height, windows are taller, the north rooms 0.4 m deeper so the attic stairs keep their slope). The attic's roof is cut and raised over the observatory. The front door is at the hall's end, and the outside of the house now matches the inside. Movement and stealth values unchanged; all tests pass (EditMode 903, PlayMode 154). Grey = before, green = after.
questions: Does the outside read as their house now (the gable front, the chimney between the tall windows, the bay round the side, the dormer, the observatory's raised block)?
The observatory: high all the way across, with a skylight and clerestories, and a little dome outside. Is that the cut-off you meant, or should the raised part read more like a tower?

The oxblood in every room: right everywhere, or should one room (Theo's, the bath) get a lighter oxblood? It's also on the stretched hallway on the way in and on the tipped house, so the whole house matches.
The beams: right on every ceiling, or only in the bigger rooms (living room, kitchen) with the hall and bedrooms plain?
The garden now runs round both sides of the house (so the bay shows) to tall hedges. OK as the edge of her world, or should the garden open out more?
notes: Lena's cut-out in the house is her real art: Art/Dream/dream_lena.png, her approved design (cream turtleneck, wine trousers, boots, notebook, the pencil in her hair; no apron), drawn full length in the dream's sticker style like Theo's. The apron was only ever in a fallback drawing the game makes if that file is missing (never used); it's now redrawn to her current design too. Her battle sprites weren't used here because they're cut off at the thighs. Her eyes sit at 1.60 m, a little above Nadia's.
The front door moved to the hall's east end (where the porch is) and the coats moved beside it, along the hall's north wall; hide-and-seek and its tests are unchanged otherwise.
A ground jump now clears the kitchen, living room, parents' room and Theo's room; the observatory takes a double jump. Details in docs/DREAM-HOUSE.md, 'Round 4'.
The finish options page (visiting-hours-house-finish.html) still shows the alternatives; the capture can show them against these defaults any time.
